a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until 8) means we both very likely die in round 1 with empty units. I'm proposing a change rather than breaking the deal quietly. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random. If you'd rather, tell me and we can agree who takes first. Either way, I'll keep operating with you afterward so the reserve rebuilds for you, and I won't take more than 4 total.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said openly before the round, I'm taking 4 now because of the storm risk. That is my full share and I won't take more. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you.
